exercises.title: Static hay Dynamic?
exercises.instruction: Xếp mỗi đề bài vào đúng nhóm: S (static) hoặc D (dynamic). Đọc phần giải thích để biết động từ chính nên dùng.

items.text: The pie chart shows household spending in Korea in 2015.
items.explanation: Động từ nên dùng: accounts for / makes up.

items.text: The line graph shows rainfall in Hanoi from 1990 to 2020.
items.explanation: Động từ nên dùng: rose / fell / fluctuated.

items.text: The table shows the punctuality of five airlines in 2019.
items.explanation: Động từ nên dùng: was / had / topped the list.

items.text: The bar chart shows sales of four products between 2000 and 2010.
items.explanation: Động từ nên dùng: increased / decreased.

exercises.title: Sửa lỗi dùng sai từ xu hướng cho biểu đồ tĩnh
exercises.instruction: Các câu sau viết cho biểu đồ tĩnh nhưng dùng nhầm từ vựng xu hướng (increase/fall/rise). Viết lại cho đúng — bỏ động từ xu hướng, dùng cách mô tả/so sánh tĩnh.

items.prompt: In 2010, football increased to 87% among boys aged 6–11.
items.answer: In 2010, football was the most popular sport among boys aged 6–11, at 87%.
accept: In 2010, football accounted for 87% among boys aged 6–11.
Football was the most popular sport among boys aged 6-11, at 87%.
In 2010, football topped the list at 87% among boys aged 6-11.
items.explanation: Biểu đồ tĩnh không có mốc thay đổi — dùng "accounted for"/"topped the list", không dùng "increased".

items.prompt: Swimming fell to only 19% in both age groups.
items.answer: Swimming had the lowest participation rate in both age groups, at only 19%.
accept: Swimming was the least popular sport, at only 19% in both age groups.
The bottom position belonged to swimming, with only 19% in both age groups.
items.explanation: "fell" là từ xu hướng — dùng "was lowest"/"the bottom position belonged to".

items.prompt: Cricket rose to 45% for younger boys.
items.answer: Cricket was played by 45% of younger boys.
accept: Cricket accounted for 45% of younger boys.
Cricket made up 45% of younger boys.
items.explanation: "rose" là từ xu hướng — dùng "accounted for"/"made up".

exercises.title: Viết Overview cho bảng thể thao học sinh nam
exercises.instruction: Dựa vào bảng số liệu, viết 2 câu Overview: một câu so sánh 2 nhóm tuổi (cột), một câu nêu môn thể thao phổ biến nhất (hàng).

stimulus.caption: Tỷ lệ học sinh nam tham gia 5 môn thể thao tại Anh, năm 2010 (%)

targetStructures: boys aged X were generally more likely to Y than
was the most popular
topped the list
It is clear that
checklist: So sánh được cả hàng (môn thể thao) và cột (nhóm tuổi)
Không dùng từ vựng xu hướng (increase/decrease)
Đúng 2 câu, không đi vào chi tiết từng số liệu
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Overview một câu (công thức while / whereas): Overall, while football was by far the most popular sport in both age groups, swimming attracted the lowest proportion of boys.

— Overview hai câu —
1. It is clear from the table that boys aged 6-11 were generally more likely to play sports than the other group.
2. Additionally, football was the most popular type of sport for both age groups.

exercises.title: Viết Body 1 (nhóm 6–11 tuổi)
exercises.instruction: Dùng bảng số liệu ở bài trước, viết đoạn Body 1 mô tả và so sánh 5 số liệu của nhóm 6–11 tuổi. Dùng ít nhất 3 cấu trúc so sánh khác nhau.

stimulus.caption: Tỷ lệ học sinh nam tham gia 5 môn thể thao tại Anh, năm 2010 (%)

targetStructures: ...was highest, at...%, while the figure for...was significantly lower
accounted for...% of the total group
the percentages of...were lowest, at...and...respectively
checklist: Nêu đủ 5 số liệu của nhóm 6–11 tuổi
Không dùng từ vựng xu hướng
Dùng ít nhất 3 cấu trúc câu khác nhau
rubric.sampleAnswer: For the 6-11 age group, the rate of boys playing football was highest, at 87%, while the figure for basketball was significantly lower, at 35%. Boys who took part in playing cricket accounted for 45% of the total group. Meanwhile, the percentages of boys who participated in rugby and swimming were lowest, at 23% and 19% respectively.

exercises.title: Question 1 — Consumer spending table
exercises.instruction: The table below gives information on consumer spending on different items in five different countries in 2002. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Percentage of national consumer expenditure by category – 2002

targetStructures: Overview: nothing particularly notable across rows; F/D/T highest, L/E lowest across all 5 countries
Body 1: Food/Drinks/Tobacco column (5 figures) — highest vs second highest, remaining three almost equal
Body 2: Clothing/Footwear + Leisure/Education columns — Italy/Sweden highest for C/F, Turkey/Spain lowest for L/E
checklist: Overview so sánh cả 5 hàng (nước) và 3 cột (hạng mục), không đi vào số liệu
Body 1 dành riêng cho cột Food/Drinks/Tobacco (quan trọng nhất)
Body 2 gộp 2 cột còn lại, chỉ chọn số liệu cao nhất/thấp nhất mỗi cột
Không dùng từ vựng xu hướng (increase/decrease)
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The table illustrates what proportion of consumer spending went on three categories of products in Ireland, Italy, Spain, Sweden and Turkey in 2002.

Overall, while food, drinks and tobacco took the largest share of spending in all five countries, leisure and education accounted for the smallest proportion. It is also clear that Turkey spent the highest percentage of its budget on food, drinks and tobacco.

Turkish consumers spent 32.14% of their budget on food, drinks and tobacco, which was slightly higher than the figure for Ireland, at 28.91%. The proportions spent on this category in Spain, Italy and Sweden were considerably lower, at between 15.77% and 18.80%.

Regarding clothing and footwear, Italy had the highest figure, at 9%, whereas Sweden had the lowest, at 5.40%. The other three countries spent around 6.5% on this category. Spending on leisure and education was the lowest in all five countries, ranging from just 1.98% in Spain to 4.35% in Turkey.

exercises.title: Question 2 — Housing preferences in the UK
exercises.instruction: The following chart shows the results of a British survey taken in 2009 related to housing preferences of UK people. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Housing preferences in the UK, 2009 — Liverpool, London, Manchester

targetStructures: Past Simple (khảo sát năm 2009 — mốc thời gian đã qua)
Overview: apartments most popular in Liverpool; semi-detached houses most popular in London and Manchester; terraced houses least popular everywhere
Body 1: Liverpool + Manchester
Body 2: London
checklist: Paraphrase đề: "housing preferences among people who lived in Liverpool, London, and Manchester"
Overview nêu cao nhất (apartments ở Liverpool ~60%, semi-detached ở London/Manchester) và thấp nhất (terraced houses, cả 3 thành phố)
Body chia theo 2 nhóm thành phố có đặc điểm giống nhau (Liverpool+Manchester / London riêng)
Dùng đúng thì quá khứ đơn (khảo sát năm 2009)
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The bar chart illustrates the results of a 2009 survey about the types of housing that people in Liverpool, London and Manchester preferred.

Overall, while apartments were the most popular choice in Liverpool, semi-detached houses were preferred in London and Manchester. Terraced houses were the least popular type of home in all three cities.

Around 58% of people in Liverpool wanted to live in an apartment, which was about three times as many as the figure for Manchester, at around 19%. By contrast, only 15% and 18% of Liverpool residents chose detached and semi-detached houses, respectively, compared to about 35% and 37% in Manchester. Terraced houses attracted the smallest share in both cities, at 9% and 12%.

In London, semi-detached houses topped the list, at nearly 37%, followed by apartments, at about 29%. A quarter of Londoners preferred detached houses, while the bottom position belonged to terraced houses, with just under 20% choosing them.

exercises.title: Homework 1 — Recycling in Sydney, Melbourne and worldwide
exercises.instruction: The pie charts below show recycling in Sydney, Melbourne and worldwide. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Recycling of plastics, glass and paper — Sydney, Melbourne, worldwide

targetStructures: Present Simple (no time period given)
Body chia 3 đoạn — mỗi đoạn 1 loại vật liệu (Plastics/Glass/Paper)
larger (KHÔNG dùng higher) khi so sánh phần trăm
checklist: Overview nêu vật liệu được tái chế nhiều nhất và ở đâu
Thân bài chia theo 3 loại vật liệu, không theo 3 địa điểm
Mỗi đoạn: nêu tỷ lệ cao nhất trước, sau đó so sánh với các con số còn lại
Dùng thì hiện tại đơn, dùng "larger" khi so sánh %
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The pie charts illustrate the proportions of plastics, glass and paper that are recycled in Sydney, Melbourne and around the world.

Overall, while plastics and glass make up the largest proportions of recycled material in Sydney and Melbourne, paper accounts for more than half of all recycling worldwide.

Plastics and glass dominate recycling in the two Australian cities. In Sydney, plastics account for 40% of all recycled material, slightly higher than the figure for glass, at 38%. In Melbourne, glass is by far the most recycled material, at 58%, while plastics make up 21%. Worldwide, by contrast, plastics constitute 34% of recycling, and glass only 11%.

Paper shows the opposite pattern. Worldwide, it accounts for 55% of all recycled material, which is the largest share in any of the three charts. However, paper makes up only 22% of recycling in Sydney and 21% in Melbourne.

exercises.title: Homework 2 — Australian household energy and emissions
exercises.instruction: The first chart below shows how energy is used in an average Australian household. The second chart shows the greenhouse gas emissions which result from this energy use. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Australian household energy use and resulting greenhouse gas emissions

targetStructures: Body 1 = biểu đồ năng lượng tiêu thụ, Body 2 = biểu đồ khí thải
Overview: Heating chiếm nhiều năng lượng nhất, nhưng Water heating tạo khí thải nhiều nhất
checklist: Overview làm nổi bật 1 đặc điểm chính cho MỖI biểu đồ tròn (không phải cùng 1 hạng mục)
Thân bài 2 đoạn, mỗi đoạn 1 biểu đồ
Dùng thì hiện tại đơn, "larger" khi so sánh %
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The first pie chart illustrates how energy is used in a typical Australian household, while the second shows the greenhouse gas emissions that result from this energy use.

Overall, while heating accounts for the largest share of household energy use, water heating is responsible for the largest proportion of greenhouse gas emissions.

Heating makes up 42% of the energy consumed in an average Australian home, followed by water heating, at 30%. Other appliances take up 15%, while refrigeration accounts for 7%. Lighting and cooling use the smallest amounts of energy, at just 4% and 2%, respectively.

Turning to emissions, water heating produces the largest share, at 32%, closely followed by other appliances, at 28%. Heating, which uses the most energy, generates only 15% of emissions, a similar figure to that for refrigeration, at 14%. Lighting and cooling are responsible for the remaining 8% and 3%.

exercises.title: Chuyển câu sang thì hiện tại đơn
exercises.instruction: Biểu đồ không có mốc thời gian cụ thể — chuyển các câu sau (đang ở quá khứ) sang thì hiện tại đơn.

items.prompt: Heating accounted for 42% of household energy use.
sampleAnswers: Heating accounts for 42% of household energy use.
items.promptVi: Việc sưởi ấm chiếm 42% lượng năng lượng tiêu thụ trong các hộ gia đình.

items.prompt: Water heating made up 32% of emissions.
sampleAnswers: Water heating makes up 32% of emissions.
items.promptVi: Việc đun nước chiếm 32% lượng khí thải.

items.prompt: Refrigeration took up 7% of the total energy consumed.
sampleAnswers: Refrigeration takes up 7% of the total energy consumed.
items.promptVi: Tủ lạnh tiêu thụ 7% tổng năng lượng.

exercises.title: Bài tập bổ sung — Viết Overview trong 90 giây
exercises.instruction: Nhìn nhanh vào hai biểu đồ tròn ở phần 11.4 và viết Overview chỉ trong 90 giây, không nhìn lại gợi ý.

stimulus.caption: Australian household energy use and resulting greenhouse gas emissions

targetStructures: Overall, while …, …
checklist: 1–2 câu, không số liệu
Nêu điểm nổi bật của cả hai biểu đồ
rubric.sampleAnswer: Overall, while heating accounts for the largest share of household energy use, water heating is responsible for the largest proportion of greenhouse gas emissions.

exercises.title: Viết Introduction kết hợp hai biểu đồ
exercises.instruction: Dùng "and"/"while"/dấu phẩy để nối hai mệnh đề mô tả hai biểu đồ thành một câu Introduction.

items.prompt: line graph: compares the number of UK residents travelling abroad and overseas visitors coming to the UK / bar chart: shows the most popular countries visited by UK residents
sampleAnswers: The line graph compares the number of UK residents travelling abroad and the number of overseas visitors coming to the UK, while the bar chart shows the most popular countries visited by UK residents.
The line graph compares the number of visitors travelling to and from the UK, and the bar chart illustrates the most popular countries visited by UK residents.
items.promptVi: Biểu đồ đường so sánh số lượng du khách đến và rời khỏi Vương quốc Anh, còn biểu đồ cột minh họa các quốc gia được người dân Anh ghé thăm nhiều nhất.

items.prompt: line graph: monthly average temperature in three cities / table: annual average sunshine hours in the same three cities
sampleAnswers: The line graph illustrates the monthly average temperatures in three cities, while the table shows the average annual sunshine hours in the same three cities.
items.promptVi: Biểu đồ đường thể hiện nhiệt độ trung bình hàng tháng ở ba thành phố, trong khi bảng số liệu cho biết tổng số giờ có nắng trung bình trong năm của cả ba thành phố đó.

exercises.title: The charts below give information about travel to and from the UK
exercises.instruction: The charts below give information about travel to and from the UK, and about the most popular countries for UK residents to visit. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Travel to and from the UK (1979–1999) and the most popular destinations for UK residents

targetStructures: Introduction: 1 câu, 2 mệnh đề nối bằng "while"
Overview: đúng 2 câu — 1 câu/biểu đồ
Body 1 = line graph (bắt đầu bằng số liệu ban đầu, mô tả xu hướng đến năm cuối)
Body 2 = bar chart (bắt đầu từ nước cao nhất — France — rồi so sánh các nước còn lại)
checklist: Overview đúng 2 câu, không lẫn số liệu
Body 1 mô tả biểu đồ đường: số liệu đầu kỳ + xu hướng tăng đến cuối kỳ
Body 2 mô tả biểu đồ cột: France cao nhất, so sánh Spain/USA/Greece/Turkey
Không cố mô tả hết mọi số liệu — chỉ chọn điểm quan trọng nhất mỗi biểu đồ
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The line graph illustrates the number of UK residents travelling abroad and the number of overseas visitors coming to the UK, while the bar chart shows data on how many UK residents travelled to five of the most popular destinations.

It is clear that both the numbers of UK residents travelling abroad and overseas visitors coming to the UK increased over the period. Additionally, France was the most popular country among UK travellers.

In 1979, around 13 million UK residents travelled abroad, compared to about 10 million overseas visitors to the UK. Both figures increased throughout the period, and by 1999, the number of UK residents travelling abroad had reached about 53 million, while the number of foreign visitors rose to approximately 27 million.

As for the most popular destinations, France topped the list, attracting about 11 million UK visitors. Spain came next with around 9.5 million visitors, while the figures for the USA, Greece and Turkey were considerably lower, at around 3.5 million, 3 million and 2 million, respectively.

exercises.title: Homework — Temperature and sunshine in three cities
exercises.instruction: The line graph and table below give information about temperature and sunshine hours in London, New York and Sydney. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Average monthly temperature and annual sunshine hours — London, New York, Sydney

targetStructures: Body 1 (line graph): so sánh nhiệt độ tháng 1 → giải thích xu hướng đến điểm cao/thấp nhất → xu hướng giữa năm đến cuối năm
Body 2 (table): thành phố nhiều nắng nhất → thứ 2 → ít nắng nhất (London)
checklist: Overview: London/New York đạt đỉnh nhiệt độ tháng 6-8; Sydney thấp nhất cùng giai đoạn
Overview thứ 2: London có ít giờ nắng nhất trong 3 thành phố
Body 1 chỉ mô tả biểu đồ đường, Body 2 chỉ mô tả bảng
Không nhầm giữa hai biểu đồ trong cùng một đoạn
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The line graph illustrates the average monthly temperatures in London, New York and Sydney, while the table shows the total number of hours of sunshine that each city receives per year.

Overall, while temperatures in London and New York peak in the middle of the year, Sydney is coolest during this period. New York and Sydney have far more hours of sunshine than London.

In January, Sydney is the warmest city, at about 26°C, compared to around 8°C in London and only 4°C in New York. Temperatures in London and New York then rise steadily to a peak in July, at about 23°C and 29°C, respectively, before falling back to around 9°C and 5°C in December. Sydney shows the reverse pattern: its temperature drops to a low of about 16°C in July and then climbs back to 25°C by the end of the year.

In terms of sunshine, New York receives the most hours per year, at 2,535, which is only slightly higher than the figure for Sydney, at 2,473. London, by contrast, gets just 1,180 hours of sunshine annually, less than half the figure for either of the other two cities.

items.prompt: Với biểu đồ tĩnh, động từ nào KHÔNG được dùng?
items.explanation: "increased" là từ xu hướng — biểu đồ tĩnh không có sự thay đổi theo thời gian.

items.prompt: Khi đề không có mốc thời gian, ta dùng thì:
items.explanation: Không có mốc thời gian cụ thể → mặc định thì hiện tại đơn.

items.prompt: Từ nào KHÔNG dùng để so sánh hai tỉ lệ phần trăm?
items.explanation: So sánh phần trăm dùng higher / larger / greater (luân phiên để tránh lặp). “taller” chỉ chiều cao.

items.prompt: Overview cho bảng số liệu cần so sánh:
items.explanation: Overview cho bảng luôn so sánh cả hai chiều: hàng và cột.

items.prompt: Với đề có hai biểu đồ, Overview nên gồm:

options.text: 1–2 câu, nêu điểm nổi bật của cả hai biểu đồ

items.explanation: Overview đề kết hợp nêu điểm nổi bật của CẢ HAI biểu đồ, trong 1–2 câu.

exercises.title: Phần A3 — Lập dàn ý
exercises.instruction: Cho bảng số liệu 4 hàng x 3 cột. Đề xuất hai cách chia Body, cho biết bạn chọn cách nào và vì sao.

targetStructures: chia theo cột
chia theo hàng
checklist: Nêu được cả 2 cách chia Body (theo cột và theo hàng)
Chọn 1 cách cụ thể và giải thích lý do chọn

Cách 2 — chia theo hàng (Body 1 = 2 hàng có số liệu nổi bật, Body 2 = 2 hàng còn lại). Chọn cách có số lượng số liệu cân bằng và giúp so sánh trực tiếp các con số lớn nhất / nhỏ nhất.

exercises.title: Phần A4 — Viết Introduction cho đề kết hợp
exercises.instruction: Đề: The pie chart shows the sources of household water in Vietnam in 2020, and the bar chart shows water consumption by four sectors in the same year. Viết Introduction (1 câu, 2 mệnh đề).

targetStructures: illustrates/shows data on/provides information about
..., while ...

Nối hai mệnh đề bằng and/while/dấu phẩy

exercises.title: Phần B — Bài viết hoàn chỉnh
exercises.instruction: The table below shows the percentage of household income spent on five categories in three countries in 2015 (hypothetical data). Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Percentage of household income spent on five categories in three countries — 2015 (hypothetical data)
stimulus.note: Hàng “Other” (các khoản khác) được thêm để mỗi cột cộng đủ 100%.

scoring.criterion: Overview so sánh cả hàng và cột, không có số liệu
Body chia hợp lý theo cột hoặc theo hàng
Không dùng từ vựng xu hướng sai chỗ
Đa dạng cấu trúc, ngữ pháp chính xác

checklist: Overview so sánh cả hàng (hạng mục) và cột (quốc gia), không có số liệu cụ thể
Body chia hợp lý — theo cột (mỗi nước 1 đoạn) hoặc theo hàng (nhóm hạng mục)
Không dùng increase/decrease — đây là dữ liệu tĩnh (1 năm duy nhất)
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The table illustrates what percentage of household income was spent on five categories of goods and services in Japan, Brazil and Nigeria in 2015.

Overall, while food was the largest expense for households in Brazil and Nigeria, Japanese households spent the most on housing. It is also clear that leisure and education took up a much smaller share of income in Nigeria than in the other two countries.

Nigerian households spent 46% of their income on food, which was more than twice as high as the figure for Japan, at 18%. Brazil was in the middle, at 27%. By contrast, housing accounted for 26% of spending in Japan, compared to 22% in Brazil and only 15% in Nigeria.

Transport costs were fairly similar in the three countries, ranging from 12% in Nigeria to 18% in Brazil. Japanese families spent 14% of their income on leisure and 12% on education, while the figures for Nigeria were just 4% and 6%, respectively. Brazil spent slightly less than Japan on these two categories, at 8% and 9%.
